# LMW Reports Stronger Textile Machinery Earnings as Order Book Reaches INR 34 Billion

LMW Ltd reported higher textile machinery revenue and first-half profit for FY2026–27, supported by improving demand and an order book of approximately INR 34 billion, although rising input costs continue to pressure margins.

The company’s Textile Machinery Division recorded second-quarter revenue of INR 6.39 billion, up approximately 38% year on year, according to its earnings-call summary.
